message: The compile-time type '{0}' cannot be nested in a run-time type. The only compile-time types that can be nested in a run-time type are classes derived from '{1}'. Move '{0}' out of the containing type.
rationale: The second sentence misses an article ('in run-time type'), and the message gives no way forward when the type is not meant to be a type fabric. Report sites: PopulateNestedCompileTimeTypes, for classes that do not derive from TypeFabric and for any compile-time struct, record, interface, enum or delegate.
